results.title: Addressing Class Imbalance in Intrusion Detection
results.content: intrusion detection; machine learning; class imbalance; classification; network security. Addressing the class imbalance is crucial in network intrusion detection, as real-world datasets tend to follow certain patterns; the vast majority of network traffic is routine, with only a small fraction representing attack-related incidents[14]. This ranking helps to identify which methods are most effective at handling different degrees of class imbalance, which is critical for optimizing model performance in scenarios where data distribution among classes is uneven. To summarize this study on machine learning approaches for IDS, we found that techniques such as Random Forest (ADASYN) and KNN (ROS) stood out as effective options for addressing imbalanced datasets across various scenarios, with elevated class imbalance ratios.
